title: Your number: link state and yearly confirmation
summary: The state of the person's linked phone number in Configurações → Privacidade → Seu número, and the one in-app notice before the yearly confirmation runs out (bipe-chat/bipe#470, bipe/docs/phone-link.md). A linked number stays findable for linkConfirmMonths after its last proof; after that, lookup skips it until the person confirms it again.

kind.description: notLinked: GET /v1/me/phone linked false. linked: confirm_by is more than linkConfirmWarnDays away. confirmSoon: confirm_by is within linkConfirmWarnDays. expired: confirm_by has passed.

confirmBy.description: confirm_by from GET /v1/me/phone. Shown with the system date formatter, date only.

noticeShown.description: true when the confirmSoon or expired notice for this confirm_by was shown on this phone.

appear.effect: Reads GET /v1/me/phone and sets phone. The privacy row number shows the value: bipe_privacy_number_not_linked, bipe_phone_linked_until (linked), bipe_phone_confirm_soon (confirmSoon, with the caution colour and the warning mark) or bipe_phone_confirm_expired (expired, same colour and mark).

checkNotice.effect: On launch and on foreground, for each signed-in account: when phone is confirmSoon or expired and no notice was shown for this confirm_by, shows one notice (bipe_phone_confirm_notice_title with bipe_phone_confirm_soon or bipe_phone_confirm_expired) and keeps that confirm_by as shown. One notice per confirm_by, never again.

confirm.effect: Hidden until bipe-chat/bipe#63 ships the SMS proof (gate planned:63). Then: runs the same proof as the link, and the API sets confirmed_at to now. A confirmation of the same number never starts a move (bipe-chat/bipe#469).

notes: Thresholds: linkConfirmMonths and linkConfirmWarnDays in registries/phone-numbers.json. The API uses linkConfirmMonths for lookup and for confirm_by; the apps use linkConfirmWarnDays. Same copy and same thresholds on both apps.
Links made by staff with the admin CLI (method admin) follow the same rule: confirmed_at is the time of the link.
The number itself never shows: GET /v1/me/phone returns only the state.
